## Key Facts

- **Chain:** BSC (Binance Smart Chain)
- **Daily Deflation:** 2.5% (50% burn + 50% distribution)
- **Circuit Breaker:** 3 tiers - 5% drop→50% slippage, 10%→70%, 20%→90%
- **Security:** Six-Zero architecture, ownership renounced
- **Entry:** 0.1 BNB minimum
- **Author:** Mr.Xuan
- **Languages:** Chinese (zh), English (en)
